candidate_definition: ATR14/close empirical percentile rank between 20th and 80th inclusive versus preceding up to 60 valid observations, excluding current bar; minimum 30 prior observations.
baseline: 20-bar breakout + SMA50 direction/slope; next-bar open entry; 12 H1 bar time exit; non-overlapping per ticker.
holdout_protocol: Final chronological 20% per ticker; no parameter selection, threshold adjustment, or model fitting on this segment. ATR percentile uses only preceding observations. Trades are entered and exited entirely inside the segment.
limitations: one archived data sample; not independent external validation
Finam H1 technical data; no live execution
fees, actual spread, slippage, borrow availability/cost and taxes omitted; costs illustrative
aggregate compounded returns across symbols are not a realizable portfolio return
holdout tested once after candidate preselection; further changes require new out-of-sample data
